title: CharacterBody2D sets platform velocity when depenetrating
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in Godot 4.3 stable, 4.1.1 stable

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable - Windows 10.0.19045 - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 SUPER (NVIDIA; 31.0.15.5186) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-6700K CPU @ 4.00GHz (8 Threads)

### Issue description

With motion mode Grounded in depenetration situation the platform velocity is set and with absurd values, that leads objects to teleport out of map.
In Grounded mode get_real_velocity() still report that velocity is set but seems a bit tamer.
In depenetration velocity shouldn't be manipulated, because it leads to frustrating character behaviors that has accumulative velocity (with acceleration, de-acceleration)

In games objects can be spawned at the same position and expected behavior is for them to pop next to each other. For depenetration to happen move_and_slide() must be called, but it flings objects with velocity.

On top of that there is no exposed way to control platform velocity from code.

### Workaround
Doesn't always work.
```
func _ready()->void:
	if test_move(global_transform, Vector2.ZERO):
		move_and_collide(Vector2(8.0, 0.0))
```

### Steps to reproduce

- create a scene with CharacterBody2D + CollisionShape2D
- in script call only move_and_slide() without setting velocity
- spawn 2x instances of that scene on top of each other (same position or slight offset)
- get_real_velocity() reports velocity not set by code
- get_platform_velocity() reports in Grounded mode

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[velocity_bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18746713/velocity_bug.zip)
